Just because you don't believe in ghosts, doesn't mean they don't believe in you!

The Only One Who Did Not Run
35190: A young man who gets easily scared is possessed by a ghost that is seeking revenge.

Impossible we do, miracle we try.

The Sickest Entry in the Nazisploitation Genre!
Commandant Conrad von Starker (as Marc Loud)

Sometimes the Body Has A Mind of Its Own.

Harry Voss/Vader Harry Voss eerste deel

Breaking up is easy to do!

Stillborn terror strikes from Tokyo Bay.

It's the picture that has the whole town shivering!

Aleksey Danishevskiy - Count, husband of Lisa

A whole new world of adventure

The war of time will begin.

Regina Torres la Asistente de Dirección

The true story of the two cops called Batman and Robin

His Guns Put Little River On The Map... And His Guns Could Wipe It Off!

Fang Miao Miao / Lee Geun Yeong

Blinded by the fury of passion - by the despair of a lost love -- she had not reckoned with "The Letter"

Homegrown terrorism decades in the making.
